children: Netflix Inc. (NFLX, Financials), the streaming company, is putting a new executive in charge of one of its most important functions.
Former Disney executive Peter Rice will step in as chief content officer Oct. 26, replacing Bela Bajaria.
Rice has expertise in television, cinema, news and sports. He's held executive positions at Disney, 21st Century Fox and Fox Searchlight.
That context is important since Netflix's challenge is no longer only attracting subscribers.

The firm is still lucrative, and still one of the biggest streaming platforms, but engagement is now more of a problem. Netflix is also trimming around 1,000 people, or about 6% of its staff, as management moves resources to areas it feels may generate better growth.
Rice will now supervise the company's worldwide slate of scripted and unscripted programs, movies and live events.
The challenge for investors is whether a new content boss can help Netflix get better at making blockbusters on a more regular basis, while keeping a lid on spending.
The appointment also comes as Netflix is expanding into deeper live content and sports.
Next, look for how Rice reshapes the content strategy, and whether engagement starts to improve when he comes over.

title: Netflix Names Former Disney Executive Peter Rice Chief Content Officer
